name: Cook Islands
facts: Self-governing in free association with New Zealand

flag.description: A dark blue field with the Union Jack in the upper hoist corner and a ring of fifteen white five-pointed stars in the fly.
flag.symbolism: The fifteen stars stand for the fifteen islands, and the ring for the unity of their people; the Union Jack recalls the link with the United Kingdom and the Commonwealth.

hook: The Cook Islands set their stars in a circle: fifteen white stars in a ring, one per island, where New Zealand and Australia scatter theirs as the Southern Cross.
trivia: From 1973 to 1979 the flag was green with a ring of fifteen golden stars.
Cook Islanders are New Zealand citizens, and far more of them live in New Zealand than in the islands.
